title: Deep lucid dream
content: Let me preface by saying I'm an experienced lucid dreamer, and have been for the last few years, but last night something weird happened. I began lucid dreaming in deep sleep. I was way down in my dream with a level of realism i had never experienced. My dreams are always vivid, but this felt very grounded like in waking life. I can always play around with the mechanics of my lucid dreams, and my usual go to is flying, but last night I couldn't do anything. I just had to walk through this dream stuck in whatever was happening. I got a little panicked because the dream began to shift quickly: I was in a full theater, then in a packed restaurant, then finally on an outdoor patio, kind of like a beer garden. Dream logic was not computing with me being lucid this deep. It was all very uncanny valley. I began asking people if I was in a dream, and most laughed at me. A few offered to take a pictures of me on their phones to prove I wasnt dreaming, but each picture I was shown was off center and obscuring me just enough that I knew it wasnt right. So then I began to get a little more forcefully with my questioning, and man, did people get mad. Aggressively mad, so much so that I knew my safest bet was to back off and just accept the gaslighting my subconscious was putting me through. The aggression in my dream was also something i hadnt experienced before. My Mallword dreams seem to follow some sort of semi-regular script, and the people that i interact with are kind of NPC's. Occasionally, I will have a dream of someone i know, but even then, the interactions follow some sort of coherent line based on our friendship/relationship. I'm not sure if I'm explaining this correctly, but it has stuck with me since I woke up. I felt so real and so tangible and I havent been able to shake it.
